'''Fanha''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Fanha system/Legends|Fanha system]], a part of the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]]<ref name="EAOC Fanha" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="WesternReaches" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Fanha" /> The [[Nineteenth Army|Nineteenth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Fanha's vicinity during the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were victorious over the [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]] in a [[Battle of Fanha/Legends|battle]] fought at Fanha as part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]], a campaign targeting [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] that was a part of the Imperial [[Reconquest of the Rim]]. In the wake of the battle, the pirate [[Lord/Legends|lord]] [[Guun Cutlax]] escaped to the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fanha was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Fanha [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Fanha, in grid square K-19.<ref name="EAOC Fanha" />
